support.notes: Same Steam build as linux-26552396 (Windows content depot 443031 manifest 7942304364241043430, recorded 2026-11-12). The shipped connector is winmm.dll, a proxy DLL placed next to ConanSandboxServer-Win64-Shipping.exe that forwards the three winmm functions the server imports and holds the Takaro connection itself (WinHTTP); no RCON, no mod. It hooks this build (PE TimeDateStamp-SizeOfImage 3b8c27b1-b6c9000, games/conan-exiles/native/core/pins/pins.json) and the previous 25792439, 25738716 and 25639945; the three anchors kept their signatures (ProcessEvent moved +0x4a10, the data globals +0x76680 vs 25792439).

notes: The Windows server is not run in a container anywhere in this repository: the runtime image is recorded only because the schema requires one, and runtime verification is off for this connector. The DLL is cross-compiled on Linux with zig 0.13.0 inside the pinned Node image (games/conan-exiles/native/platform/windows/Dockerfile.builder). The redistributable depot 1004 is pinned because the proven install carried it; it is not watched (Valve's depot).
